subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 be split into focused core TUI default-session, sessions_send channel, WeChat plugin/core routing, background-event isolation, and session-activity ordering items, and which owner boundary should own each?
rationale: Source inspection proves several unresolved subproblems, but the WeChat/deadlock parts cross external plugin ownership and the activity/deadlock fixes require product semantics that automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Split and route the umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open only as the parent until focused follow-ups are attached to the relevant core and plugin owners, with #51028 and #93255 kept as canonical partial overlaps.

options.title: Keep as one broad issue
options.body: Preserve all evidence in one item, but any repair path will be hard to validate and easy to partially close incorrectly.

options.title: Close after linking partial siblings
options.body: Close this as superseded by #51028 and #93255, but that would drop the TUI default-session, WeChat identity, and background-event deadlock evidence.

recommendation.title: Split and route the umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only as the parent until focused follow-ups are attached to the relevant core and plugin owners, with #51028 and #93255 kept as canonical partial overlaps.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest visible history across session UI/routing and WeChat documentation boundaries needed for the split decision.
